top_signals.title: Kiran Nadar's $850 Million-Plus Art Bet to Build a Museum-Going India
top_signals.summary: Kiran Nadar, wife of tech tycoon Shiv Nadar, has built one of the world’s most significant private art collections. Now she’s building a museum to match. In a conversation with Bloomberg’s Menaka Doshi, Nadar discusses her 17,000-work collection, India’s booming art market and her biggest ambition: to democratize art and turn more Indians into museumgoers. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: Hedge funds are loading up on options that will profit if the euro weakens against the dollar as political and fiscal risks mount in France.
